item.text: The failure is in `server/evaluator.go`: disabled flags currently produce `ErrInvalid`, and the batch loop treats every error as fatal. The server also still uses the legacy protobuf timestamp and empty message packages; I’m checking the generated RPC types and response schema before changing those imports and fields.
